title: shorea helferi
intro: Shorea helferi, commonly known as Helfer's Shorea, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant is native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia, where it is prized for its timber and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Shorea helferi include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, making it a valuable natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
